blocks.text: Graphical representation of software systems involves using visual diagrams to depict various aspects of a software system's structure and behavior. This approach helps in simplifying complex systems, making it easier for developers and stakeholders to understand, communicate, and manage the system. Diagrams, like Unified Modeling Language (UML) diagrams, are widely used to illustrate various components, their relationships, and interactions within software.
